verdict.rationale: AvaTax's CreateTransaction API lists 'returns' as a supported transaction type alongside sales/purchases (avalara-docs-22), implying refund transactions are recorded and taxed, and Managed Returns API links transaction data to filings (avalara-docs-31). But there's no documentation specifically describing credit-note/negative-amount handling flowing correctly through liability reports or the next filing without manual journal adjustments. Missing for 10: explicit docs on refund/credit-note transaction types (e.g. Return/ReturnInvoice document types), evidence negative amounts net correctly in liability worksheets, and confirmation no manual journal fixes are needed before filing.
